approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: A serene photorealistic ocean shoreline at sunset for a meditation app. Small gentle waves slowly roll onto smooth wet sand and recede, reflecting soft peach, muted rose and warm golden sunset light. Wide uncluttered composition, level horizon in upper third, sun low above the distant ocean, delicate pastel clouds. Locked-off stationary camera, single continuous shot, slow soothing natural movement, low contrast, no abrupt changes. No people, boats, buildings, text or logos. Consistent lighting and framing, suitable for repeating as a calming background. Audio: quiet natural ocean surf only, no music, no speech, no harsh sounds.
